+Fix AgGrid formatter demo exports by bundling memoized cell renderers from their generated module.

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+"""Regression coverage for the formatter demo's runtime cell renderers."""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+# Demo imports register states and pages for the lifetime of the interpreter.
+# Keep them out of the shared registry used by unrelated app-compilation tests.
+_PROBE = """
+import inspect
+import sys
+
+from reflex.components import dynamic
+from reflex.utils.format import json_dumps
+
+from reflex_enterprise.vars import get_bundled_libraries
+
+sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
+from ag_grid import formatters
+
+# Reflex 0.9.6 clears registrations after importing the app, before pages.
+dynamic.reset_bundled_libraries()
+dynamic.bundle_library("@radix-ui/themes")
+# Test the formatter page without the demo navigation/source viewer wrapper.
+page = inspect.unwrap(formatters.formatter_page)()
+
+memo_module = formatters.row_counter(rowid="").library
+assert memo_module in get_bundled_libraries()
+# Exercise both compile-time traversal and backend/API serialization.
+assert page._get_all_imports()
+assert memo_module in json_dumps(formatters.cols_defs)
+"""
+
+
+def test_formatter_page_bundles_memo_after_compiler_reset():
+    demo_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "demos" / "ag_grid"
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", _PROBE, str(demo_dir)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        encoding="utf-8",
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, f"{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}"
